title: Draft agent runs without output_schema; JSON parsed from raw text
answers: Why does the support draft not send output_schema?
Draft poll fails with 'no agent message'
How is the draft JSON parsed from the agent reply?
body:
The support draft calls `MultiTurnSession.start_raw` with no `output_schema` in `products/conversations/backend/temporal/ai_reply/activities/draft.py:_draft_async`.
- With a schema set, storing the output completes the task run before an agent message reaches the log, so the poll fails with "no agent message". Do not restore `output_schema` on the draft.
- Parsing is `_parse_draft`. It takes the last JSON object in the text that validates as `SupportReplyDraft`, so example or ticket JSON before the answer is ignored.
- If the first turn has no draft JSON, `_draft_from_session` sends one follow-up (`_DRAFT_JSON_NUDGE`) with `_DRAFT_NUDGE_POLL_SECONDS`. The first poll plus two nudge polls must fit in the activity's 20 minute start_to_close timeout.
- Confidence 0–1 coercion still guards bad scores. The other one-shot model calls keep their JSON schemas.
- Handling stays in `products/conversations`. Do not change the shared runner in `products/tasks`, which would affect other callers.
applies: support reply draft activity and its use of MultiTurnSession from the tasks facade
